units.source_text: 一個念頭閃過腦海——什麼都行，反正這世上沒有讓我快樂的東西。

en.t: A thought flashed through my mind: anything would do, since in any case there was nothing in this world that could make me happy.

units.source_text: 同時，別人送給我的東西，無論多麼不合我意，我也不會拒絕。

en.t: At the same time, I would not refuse anything someone gave me, no matter how little it suited my taste.

units.source_text: 對討厭的事不能說討厭，對喜歡的事情也像行竊一樣戰戰兢兢，從而在極度苦澀的滋味和難以言表的痛苦中苦悶得不能自拔。

en.t: I could not say I disliked what I disliked, and even with things I liked I trembled as if stealing them, sinking helplessly into an extremely bitter feeling and an indescribable pain.

units.source_text: 總之，我缺乏在喜歡與厭惡二者之間的選擇能力。

en.t: In short, I lacked the ability to choose between liking and disliking.

units.source_text: 我想，多年來，恰恰是這種性格，才是我所謂「羞恥無數」的人生的重要原因。

en.t: I think that over the years this very trait became an important cause of what I called my life of countless shames.

units.source_text: 見我扭扭捏捏一聲不吭，父親一臉不悅地說：「還是要書嗎？

en.t: Seeing me fidget in silence, my father said with a displeased look, "So it is books after all?"
